name: Sheraton Rhodes Resort
positioning: Beach resort in Ixia on Rhodes, set in gardens in front of an exclusive access beach, with three outdoor pools and Chanti Spa, 4 kilometers from the Medieval Town of Rhodes
best_for: Families who want a Kids' Club with a children's pool, sports courts and beach water sports
Couples who want a sea-view balcony room with a Jacuzzi and time at the spa

facts.text: The resort is in Ixia, 4 kilometers from the Medieval Town of Rhodes.
The UNESCO-listed Medieval City of Rhodes, with its cobbled streets, is a short drive from the resort.
Each guest room has a private furnished balcony with mountain or Aegean Sea views.
The Penthouse Suite has a king bed, a sea view, a balcony and a terrace.
Aelia, the presidential suite, has its own dining and living areas.
Rooms have en-suite marble bathrooms with walk-in showers.
The resort has three outdoor swimming pools.
Chanti Spa offers holistic treatments using Greek ingredients treasured for centuries.
The resort has squash, tennis and basketball courts.
Water sports are available at the beach.
The Kids' Club is for children 4 to 12 years old and has a children's pool and special activities.
Thea is the resort's Greek restaurant, using local ingredients.

highlights.text: The exclusive access beach is reached through an underground passageway and has sun beds, large straw umbrellas, towels and beach staff.
The resort is set in lush gardens with an exclusive access beach in front of it.
The Aqua Deluxe Room has views over the Aegean Sea and a modern Jacuzzi on its balcony.
Chanti Spa has an indoor pool, sauna, Jacuzzi and cold plunge.
Knights' Bar is on the sixth floor and has panoramic views of the sea and sky.

considerations.text: The resort's meeting and event venues have capacity for up to 1,600 guests.
WhataHotel notes the popular tourist area can be crowded during peak season.
